title: introduce-rapid-regen-fallback-and-slo-invariant-keeper-regional-circuit-coordinator-hotpatch
author: Maya Chen
description: Problem: During a regional overload incident on 2026-02-22 we observed aggressive circuit flips and tenant thrashing when regional nodes attempted to rejoin after transient KV pressure. That led to repeated SLO violations at p95 and p99 for conversational routes. The existing regional circuit state machine was too eager to reopen and lacked coordination across nodes, which amplified token-cost storms and caused cascading backpressure. Goal: Introduce a small, low-risk coordinator and a conservative fallback mode that (1) prevents rapid-open/rapid-close loops across a region (Rapid Regen Fallback), (2) enforces a soft SLO invariant at the admission layer (SLO Invariant Keeper) to prevent global SLO regressions, and (3) provide telemetry + a one-button rollback. This PR is a targeted hotpatch (branch hotfix/rapid-regen-slo-keeper) intended to be applied quickly to release and staging and then merged to main after verification. Design summary: - Regional Circuit Coordinator (new component) maintains ephemeral region-level state: recent reopen_attempts, probation windows, and a token budget for reopens. Coordinator exposes a REST/gRPC probe and integrates with the existing circuit manager via a lightweight lease (backed by existing coordination KV). - Rapid Regen Fallback: when a node attempts to reopen a circuit, the coordinator evaluates reopen_budget and recent_failures. If the budget is exhausted the node is placed into a rapid-regen fallback state: reject reopen, keep serving existing cached responses (fastpath), and begin a longer, randomized backoff with telemetry. - SLO Invariant Keeper: admission controller consults regional SLO metrics (rolling p95 proxy latency, failed_responses) and will gracefully degrade admission (soft-deny new long-run requests and route them to a lower-cost model variant or a queued fastpath) when the invariant is under pressure. Degradation is rank-preserving (preserves highest-priority tenants first). - Safety and rollback: feature gated behind runtime flag enable_rapid_regen and a canary rollout policy. There is a manual revert script included. All new behavior has opt-outs via per-tenant config. What changed (high level): - pkg/coordination/regional_circuit_coordinator.go (new): coordinator logic and lease handling. - internal/admission/slo_invariant_keeper.go (new): admission rules and degradation policies. - runtime/config/flags.go: new flags for gating and thresholds. - api/telemetry/metrics.yaml: added metrics definitions and dashboard pointers. - cmd/ops/revert_hotpatch.sh: rollback helper. - tests/*: unit + e2e scenarios for circuit stability and graceful degrade. Rollout plan: 1) Deploy to staging with canary=false for 4 hours, watch slo_invariant.violation_count and circuit_coordinator.reopen_rate. 2) Canary exact 10% of production traffic for region-eu-west for 1 hour. 3) Expand to 50% then 100% if no regressions. Metrics to watch: slo_invariant.violation_count, circuit_coordinator.reopen_attempts, route.p95_token_latency, tenant.priority_failures. Rollback plan: run cmd/ops/revert_hotpatch.sh or disable enable_rapid_regen via runtime config and ensure coordinator drains. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for coordinator state transitions - [x] Integration test simulating KV pressure rejoin pattern - [x] Metrics and dashboards updated - [x] Can be toggled off per-tenant - [x] Ops revert script included Risks and mitigations: - If coordinator lease cannot be acquired (KV partition), nodes fall back to local conservative behavior (no reopen for configured ttl). This is explicitly tested. - Potential for increased latency for low-priority tenants; mitigated by tiered degrade and observability. Reference: incident SUP-8742, related design note ENG-3421.

release_notes: Hotpatch: add regional circuit coordinator and SLO Invariant Keeper. Enables safe, coordinated reopen backoff and admission-based graceful degradation to protect global SLOs. Feature gated, default off. Ops: canary rollout instructions and revert script included.
notes_for_oncall: If you observe an increase in slo_invariant.violation_count after enabling, disable enable_rapid_regen immediately. If coordinator lease errors surface, the nodes will fallback to local conservative ttl-based no-reopen behavior; watch circuit_coordinator.lease_errors metric and escalate to infra-team if >5/min for >5m.
